description: Send (or resend) the one-time code that verifies the person’s email for this request. Needed before the sample is shown (sampling itself starts at once), and again before payment if the verification is older than the re-verify window. human_email may be corrected only before it is verified. Use when next_action is start_email_verification (email_verification.state not_sent, unavailable, expired, replaced or attempts_exceeded after resend_after). Ask the person to give you the code and to check spam; if the state stays unavailable after requesting a new code once, ask them to contact support@getmydata.io; this code email contains no price or link (the later quote email contains the private payment link).
name: start_email_verification
title: Send email code
